objective: Add authenticated, bounded Start button for a fixed OpenAI code-writing GitHub Actions workflow without exposing public GitHub write/model spend authority.
scope: Keep public Mission Control read-only without login.
Expose nonsecret GET /api/launcher and protected POST /api/launch for owner-initiated fixed workflow.
Require strong owner token, strict same-origin and a fixed action, limited cooldown and no automatic retry of ambiguous Github requests.
Show truthful dispatch states via SSE, preserve GitHub Actions exact logs for real evidence.
Test authorization failures, request deduplication, HTTP 202 dispatch, missing configuration and safe public API.
out_of_scope: Anonymous paid model or arbitrary task execution.
Direct write to protected GitHub main, CI gate bypass, live exchange orders, funding accounts.
Automatic model/test success declaration from a 202 dispatch response.
Storing tokens in dashboard JavaScript, LocalStorage, public URLs or GitHub source.
secrets: NQ_GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN (private Render, fine-grained Actions write only)
OPENAI_API_KEY (GitHub Actions only, separate and billed)
tests: Exact-head Mission Control API Verification and Governance Verify
Public Render /api/launcher verified BLOCKED if owner secrets missing
Full owner-authenticated real dispatch smoke test only after secure secret provisioning and WZ-008 protected merge.
security_tests: Deny incorrect bearer, cross-site origin, arbitrary task/path/model parameters.
1800-second per instance cooldown and no retry for ambiguous 502.
Never store owner token browser-side or expose in API status.
No live trading nor paid calls from anonymous Start audit.
rollback: Revert scoped changes via separate PR and unset owner dispatch token in Render private environment.
definition_of_ready: Model runner is independently reviewed and approved before setting dispatch URL live.
Auth and capacity constraints fail closed.
definition_of_done: Exact-head tests and independent review pass.
Preview deployed with safe BLOCKED state when unconfigured.
An actual 204 Github workflow dispatch observed only after owner private setup.
Resulting model generation/test/PR evidence verified on GitHub.
No bypass of A5/A8/A10, owner gates or Live ban.
